prompt:
Style: japanese-hand-drawn. Transform the supplied ORIGINAL photograph of a LEGO Millennium Falcon model on a white cabinet, minifigures, a display plaque and nearby autumn foliage. Render only a single full-frame artwork using this style treatment:

- **Illustration — simplification.** The scene is reduced to its main subject, action or defining feature — a look, a pose, a building outline, a distinctive small corner — and roughly 70% of the frame is left blank, on a lightly textured paper-like ground. - **Illustration — linework.** Japanese minimalist manga editorial design with expressive hand-drawn ink: strokes vary in thickness, uneven, with dry-brush and broken passages as if drawn stroke by stroke, plus solid black blocks and manga halftone (screentone) dots that give the subject volume. - **Illustration — color.** Black-and-white ink lines recombined with one or two of the source photo's most representative colors (e.g. blue-green for street dance, sky blue for extreme cycling, clay-orange for tennis). The prompt ends with a self-check against those rules. 

Preserve the original scene's subject relationships. Every part of the canvas must belong to the transformed artwork. No original photo panel, no before/after comparison, no split, no text.
reference_method: isolated single-source batch; image results withheld until all calls completed; per-image Git checkpoint
